facts.value: Enters the directional floor-recovery motion ID selected by ftCo_Down_CheckInput without modifying that ID. The caller selects a U variant only from DownWaitU; other current states, including DownBoundU, select D.
facts.rationale: Replace universal orientation-preservation language with independently verified caller discrimination.

evidence.why: Exact discriminator and unchanged entry argument.

facts.value: Accepts qualifying C-stick horizontal threshold crossing preferentially, otherwise qualifying left-stick magnitude, and enters facing-relative DownFoward or DownBack recovery. Both routes use a signed upper-angle bound. U is selected only from DownWaitU; all other current motions select D. Returns whether entry occurred, without locally consuming/resetting input counters.
facts.rationale: Repair generalized orientation preservation and symmetric near-horizontal interpretation while preserving canonical spelling.

facts.value: C-stick acceptance requires previous abs(X) < x248, current abs(X) >= x248, and atan2f(current Y, abs(current X)) < x20_radians. Otherwise left-stick acceptance requires current abs(X) >= x248 and the same signed angle bound, with no crossing requirement. Neither passing returns false before local entry. Accepted X * facing_dir >= 0 selects DownFoward, otherwise DownBack; only DownWaitU selects U. Zero products go forward; under ordinary unordered comparisons a NaN product goes backward. DownBound_Anim also invokes this routine, so DownBoundU selects D. Exact target exceptional atan2f behavior is not established.
facts.rationale: Document strict/inclusive boundaries, signed-angle asymmetry, source-level exceptional comparison behavior, and actual cross-file consumer.

facts.value: Directional dispatch prioritizes C-stick crossing over left-stick magnitude and applies signed angle < x20_radians. Facing-adjusted X >= 0 selects DownFoward, otherwise DownBack; only DownWaitU selects U. The separate buffered attack predicate accepts A/B age counters strictly below x24C or an upward C-stick Y threshold crossing and selects DownAttackU only from DownBoundU. Directional Anim delegates completion, IASA is empty, Phys delegates ground movement, and Coll can enter Fall on failed collision support. These exact state tests do not implement universal orientation preservation.
facts.rationale: Replace overbroad orientation-matched summary, noncanonical spelling, and incomplete exit description.
